keySentence: Every single minute of the journey counted.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: They saw a woman in danger. Fogg stopped to help her. Some things matter more than time. Every single minute of the journey counted.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: While crossing the jungle on the elephant, they saw a woman being led to danger. Fogg knew stopping would cost precious time from his schedule. But he believed that helping someone in need is more important than any bet. Together with Passepartout, they made a plan to rescue the woman. Every single minute of the journey counted. This moment showed that Fogg had a good heart beneath his calm exterior.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: As they traveled through the Indian jungle, Fogg's group witnessed a disturbing procession. A young woman named Aouda was being taken against her will to a terrible fate. Fogg calculated that stopping to help would cost them at least twelve precious hours. Despite this, he made an immediate decision — rescuing Aouda was the right thing to do. Every single minute of the journey counted. However, the rescue mission was extremely dangerous and could have ended the journey entirely. Because Fogg valued human life above money and schedules, he did not hesitate for even a moment. Passepartout's clever disguise and bravery were essential to the daring rescue plan.
